definitions.supplemental: seáw is masculine in Lch. ii. 18, 14, though in the preceding line it is neuter :-- Dó þ-bar; seáw on neb . . . þ-bar; se seáw (perhaps there is confusion owing to the conjunctional þ-bar; and the initial letter of seáw ?) mæge þ-bar; heáfod geondyrnan

quotations.old_english: Genim þisse sylfan wyrte (foxglove) seáw mid rosan seáwe,
Þicgen þá mettas ðe gód seáw wyrcen,

source_text: seáw. Add [seáw is masculine in Lch. ii. 18, 14, though in the preceding line it is neuter :-- Dó þ-bar; seáw on neb . . . þ-bar; se seáw (perhaps there is confusion owing to the conjunctional þ-bar; and the initial letter of seáw ?) mæge þ-bar; heáfod geondyrnan] :-- Genim þisse sylfan wyrte (foxglove) seáw mid rosan seáwe, Lch. i. 268, 5. Þicgen þá mettas ðe gód seáw wyrcen, ii. 226, 12. [v. N. E. D. sew.]
